jobs.title: Director of Product, ClickHouse Cloud
jobs.description:
As Director of Product Management, you'll define the multi-year strategy for the ClickHouse Cloud platform. You'll lead the product direction for foundational cloud capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, storage architecture, and release management working closely with Engineering leadership to ensure ClickHouse Cloud continues to scale with the needs of our customers.


YOU WILL

 - Define the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, covering cloud-native database capabilities including multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, schema evolution, and disaster recovery.

 - Partner closely with Engineering leadership to prioritize investments across the core database engine, storage layer, and query execution framework, ensuring Cloud evolves alongside our open-source platform while meeting enterprise customer needs.

 - Coach and mentor Product Managers across adjacent platform areas, helping drive prioritization, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain a cohesive platform strategy.

 - Partner with Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success to deliver compelling product launches and customer experiences.

 - Balance long-term platform investments with near-term customer commitments and business priorities.

 - Partner with Engineering leadership to make informed investment and resourcing decisions across the platform roadmap.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and cross-functional partners, providing clear visibility into product strategy, execution, risks, and trade-offs.

 - Represent ClickHouse with strategic customers, partners, and at industry events, translating customer needs into long-term product direction.


YOU BRING

 - 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience defining strategy for cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, developer platforms, or database products.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence product direction across multiple engineering teams and drive large cross-functional initiatives.

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and modern data infrastructure.

 - Comfortable working at both strategic and technical levels, partnering closely with senior engineering leaders on architectural decisions.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, executives, customers, and external audiences.


TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

 - Strong understanding of SQL, query execution, indexing, partitioning, and database performance optimization.

 - Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other distributed or analytical database systems.

 - Familiarity with modern data infrastructure, including data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC, orchestration platforms, and cloud-native data architectures.

 - Ability to discuss technical concepts such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, replication, consistency models, backup and recovery, and distributed systems design with engineering teams.

 - Experience shipping or contributing to complex infrastructure capabilities such as replication, disaster recovery, storage systems, consistency models, or backup and restore workflows.


LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE

 - Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

 - Experience representing products with customers, analysts, or at industry conferences.

 - Track record of coaching, mentoring, or guiding Product Managers, either formally or informally.


BONUS

 - Experience working on or contributing to open-source projects.

 - Experience in high-growth startup environments.


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Security
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in security to join our dynamic team. This role will be crucial in defining and executing the product strategy for our security offerings, ensuring our products are robust, reliable, and secure, and that they meet the evolving needs of our customers. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of database security, networking, and identity management, and will be adept at navigating the complexities of product development from conception to launch.

What you will do:

 - Define and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for security-focused features and products.

 - Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback sessions to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

 - Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver high-quality, secure products.

 - Translate complex security requirements into clear, concise product specifications and user stories.

 - Prioritize product backlog and manage trade-offs to optimize for business value and customer satisfaction.

 - Drive product launch activities, including go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and user documentation.

 - Monitor product performance, gather insights, and iterate on product features based on data and user feedback.

 - Act as a subject matter expert for security within the organization, providing guidance and insights to various stakeholders.

About You:

 - Minimum of 8+ years of experience in product management in B2B SaaS, with a significant focus on security products or features.

 - Proven experience with database security principles and best practices.

 - Strong understanding of networking concepts and their implications for security.

 - In-depth knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) topics.

 - Certifications in security (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+).

 - Demonstrated experience in quality assurance processes and methodologies.

 - Solid background in program management, including planning, execution, and risk management.

 - Prior experience in security engineering is required.

 - Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Prior experience securing a data platform, database product, or real-time analytics service.

 - Familiarity with ClickHouse or other databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

 - Experience supporting BYOC or private deployment models.

 - Background working with open source software or developer-focused products.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Security
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Director of Product Management to own our security product strategy end to end -   the vision, the roadmap, build vs buy decisions. You will set the multi-year investment strategy for our security offerings, go deep with engineering on database security, networking, and identity management. You will be the subject matter expert for other PMs navigating security-adjacent decisions..

Responsibilities

 - Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for our security offerings, and make the case for it - internally with engineering and leadership, and externally with customers and the market.

 - Go deep on database security, networking, and identity and access management (IAM) - enough to argue the details with engineering, not just approve what they propose.

 - Partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship products that are actually secure, not just marketed that way.

 - Translate complex security requirements into specifications and user stories that engineering can understand.

 - Own backlog prioritization and the trade-offs that come with it, weighing business value, customer risk, and engineering cost.

 - Drive go-to-market for security launches - positioning, sales enablement, documentation.

 - Monitor how security features perform in the real world and use that data, not just instinct, to decide what to build next.

 - Be the security subject-matter expert other teams come to, and provide guidance and coaching to PMs working on security-adjacent problems elsewhere in the org.

 - Represent our security posture and roadmap externally - with top customers, prospects, and analysts when the conversation needs someone who actually understands the tradeoffs.

Qualifications

Feature Ideation, Definition, and Development

Cross-functional Leadership and Collaboration

 - Every project requires collaboration between various teams at ClickHouse and you are the glue that holds them together. You will be responsible for coordinating with partners on the design, engineering, and security teams to ensure that they are aligned on scope and timeline for each project.  You will also be principally in-charge of identifying, communicating, and resolving cross-team blockers and dependencies.

jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

Since being acquired by ClickHouse, with access to ClickHouse's broader GTM resources, Langfuse now has a growing enterprise motion and a large self-hosted user base.

This role exists to give Langfuse a clear, accurate narrative that is easier to understand and adopt.

 


HOW THE ROLE WORKS

This role is for a product marketer who likes technical depth. A technical background is a strong plus, you should be technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.

You'll become a true power user of Langfuse, and gain a front-row seat into how the best AI teams build production applications.

You should expect close working relationships with both Langfuse teams and ClickHouse’s product marketing, sales and regional GTM teams.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - ClickStack
jobs.description:
ClickHouse is looking for a Product Manager to join the ClickStack team and own major parts of the product end to end.

This is a hands-on product role. You’ll work directly with customers, use and instrument the product yourself, develop a deep understanding of the underlying systems, and turn that understanding into a shipped product. Initial focus areas are likely to include ClickStack onboarding and cloud workflows, alerting, and the broader telemetry ingestion and integration ecosystem.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major observability product areas from customer discovery through product definition, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

 - Take ownership of areas such as alerting, anomaly detection, onboarding, provisioning, and telemetry integrations.

 - Work directly with customers and prospects to understand observability use cases, migration requirements, operational workflows, and emerging needs.

 - Improve the end-to-end onboarding experience, including getting telemetry into ClickStack, configuring the product, and migrating from existing observability platforms.

 - Drive integrations across the observability ecosystem, including OpenTelemetry and common cloud, infrastructure, and logging sources.

 - Act as user 0. Set up environments yourself, instrument applications, send telemetry, reproduce customer workflows, and use the product at a meaningful scale.

 - Work closely with engineering and design, including prototyping workflows yourself when useful rather than relying exclusively on written requirements.

 - Design end-to-end observability experiences with both engineers and AI agents as first-class users.

 - Coordinate broadly across teams and products where ClickStack depends on or integrates with other parts of the ClickHouse ecosystem and external products.

 - Work across product boundaries to shape cohesive experiences spanning ClickStack, ClickHouse Cloud, and complementary products and integrations.

 - Stay close to customers after shipping and use adoption, product data, and direct feedback to determine what needs to improve next.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience driving an observability product or platform in a similar-stage or later-stage company.

 - A proven track record of shipping successful products in the observability SaaS space.

 - Strong technical depth. You’re comfortable moving from a user workflow into telemetry pipelines, APIs, schemas, queries, databases, and infrastructure when necessary.

 - A hands-on working style. You’re comfortable deploying software, instrumenting applications, debugging integrations, querying data, and ideally building prototypes or contributing code.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into concrete product decisions.

 - Comfort working directly with technical users and enterprise customers, including during migrations and complex evaluations.

 - Comfort operating in a dynamic environment where priorities, ownership boundaries, and the problems that need attention can change quickly.

 - Strong written and verbal communication with engineering, design, customers, field teams, and leadership.

 - Experience working with and enabling a large and diverse sales team, supporting enterprise customers and complex sales cycles.

 - Experience engaging with open source communities, including managing community expectations and incorporating community-driven input and contributions.

 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and the broader observability ecosystem.
